items.title: Preserve FlexClone space efficiency when migrating to Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
items.summary: What happens when you need to migrate between separate ONTAP file systems but have multiple long-lived clones? Whether you are moving from on-premises NetApp to Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, between FSx file systems, or across AWS accounts, preserving these clone relationships becomes critical. Standard file-based migration tools like rsync, robocopy, or AWS DataSync have […]
